Sync settings

One-time per device: paste the Deck Bridge /exec URL and bridge key. Every status and note then writes to the Command Center within a second, the plan loads on open, and End my day files the Activity row. Nothing lives only on this phone.

Email to Command Center






Don't let the "I don't want to" win.


The evening wrap: tap End my day, check the four totals, then Send to Command Center — the Activity row and the full log write straight into the sheet. Email and the pasted Activity row are the backups if the bridge is unreachable.


Dialling: tap a number to call (in the installed app). Text and Email open with the message already written. Copy puts the number on the clipboard.


Statuses: the blue row is what you did (LM, DLM for a call with no message, TX, EM, BAD# for a dead number). The traffic-light row is what came of it. LM and DLM count up, so each card tells you how many times you have tried.


Every tap writes to the Command Center as you make it. If the phone is offline the taps queue up and go the moment signal returns.
